name: Duramon
main_effect:
[Hand] [Main] By paying 2 cost and placing this card as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your Digimon that's level 5 or has the [Legend-Arms] trait, that Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an effect places a digivolution card under this Digimon, this Digimon gains ＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.) and ＜Piercing＞ for the turn. (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon's attack target is switched, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
